herbivora.definition:
n. pl. An extensive division of Mammalia. It formerly
   included the Proboscidea, Hyracoidea, Perissodactyla, and Artiodactyla,
   but by later writers it is generally restricted to the two latter
   groups (Ungulata). They feed almost exclusively upon vegetation.

herbivore.definition: n. any animal that feeds chiefly on grass and other plants

herbivores.definition: n. any animal that feeds chiefly on grass and other plants
herbivores.translation: n. 食草动物( herbivore的复数形式 )

[医] 草食的, 食草的

herbivory.translation: n. 食草, 食植物（习惯）

herbless.definition: a. Destitute of herbs or of vegetation.

herborization.definition:
n. The act of herborizing.

herborize.definition:

   reference to minerals. See Arborized.
